series.ja: 機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN

description.ja: • ガンダムエースで連載中の「機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN MSD ククルス・ドアンの島」に登場する黒い局地型ガンダムがHG化！
description.en: • The black local Gundam that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam THE ORIGIN MSD Cucurrus Doan Island" currently being serialized in Gundam Ace has been made into HG!

description.ja: • 機体色はもちろん、作中でも印象的なショルダー・キャノンは新規造形で再現され、ランドセルにはシールドとMS用マシンガンを懸架出来るジョイントパーツが付属！
description.en: • In addition to the body color, the shoulder cannon, which is impressive in the series, has been recreated with new modeling, and the school bag comes with joint parts that allow you to hang the Seal and MS machine gun!

description.ja: • 特徴的な全身の赤いラインマークは新規デザインのデカールで再現されている！
description.en: • The characteristic red line mark all over the body is reproduced with a newly designed decal!
